desc: 暗场硬光卤味零食套图，光泽微距与空白参数卡体系
leaf: 卤香即食肉制品小包装零食
name: 暗场卤香肉制品零食款

shots.intent: 在搜索列表里用一记硬光光泽抓住第一眼点击
用一处极近距离的油润纹理先把食欲坐实
shots.textZone: top right hairline label slot reading 「{callout_1}」

shots.intent: 把这一款最核心的一条主张用一秒读完
戳中同类冷吃发干发柴、味不入里的落差
把零食放进真实的分享与追剧时刻里
用同一块料的前后两态讲清工艺叙事
shots.textZone: one label slot per panel reading 「{callout_4}」 and 「{callout_5}」

shots.intent: 用一张结构化参数卡消解规格与携带疑虑
shots.textZone: card headline slot 「{callout_6}」 with blank parameter rows beneath

shots.intent: 给出多口味多规格的可选货架感
shots.textZone: three blank capsule slots under the columns reading 「{callout_7}」

shots.intent: 用留白的凭证家具承接质检与溯源叙事
shots.textZone: seal frame and capsule slots carrying only 「{callout_8}」

shots.intent: 把随身带、随手撕的结构便利讲清楚
shots.textZone: small callout slot near the notch reading 「{callout_3}」

shots.intent: 以食欲堆叠加一个空白动作位收住整屏

style.backgroundSystem: matte charcoal-black studio field #121013 with one warm pool of light and a deep falloff, alternating screen by screen with a pale porcelain card plane #F5EFE4; a coarse umber jute runner #6B4527 or black ribbed slate #1A1614 is the only texture, never a bright room or an outdoor set
style.iconSystem: hairline single-stroke icon in #E9A93D plus blank proof furniture: empty double-ring seal frame, empty capsule slots, empty parameter rows; no filled, gradient or embossed badges
style.lightingSystem: warm low-key single-source studio light, hard key from the right at 3400K with a black flag on the left, tight glossy speculars on the glazed food surface, soft contact shadow under the dish, deep unlit falloff behind
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent premium dark-stage braised-snack visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of matte charcoal-black field #121013, pale porcelain card #F5EFE4, chilli-red accent #B33A2B and braise-gold highlight #E9A93D; warm low-key studio lighting with one hard right-side key at 3400K, a black flag on the left, tight glossy speculars on the glazed surface, soft contact shadow and deep falloff behind; coarse umber jute weave #6B4527 or black ribbed slate #1A1614 as the only surface textures; bold condensed CJK display headline over a hairline Latin kicker with a thin dotted rule; hairline #E9A93D icon plus blank proof furniture (empty double-ring seal frame, empty capsule slots, empty parameter rows) and every in-image word kept as a placeholder slot; stable product scale and placement; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no bright daylight kitchen scene.
noDrift: no color palette changes and no fourth accent hue
no mixed fonts and no brush calligraphy
no bright daylight kitchen or outdoor scene
no inconsistent lighting and no soft even wrap-around light
no filled certification badges, seals or numeric proof marks
no mismatched icon styles and no 3D rendered icons
style.presentationRules: food served in a tidy low pyramid or one loose layer on an unprinted dish, never overlapping the headline block; packaging shown only as a plain unbranded pouch with an empty label band; product scale stable within one tenth across screens
style.surfaceSystem: black ribbed slate #1A1614 and coarse umber jute weave #6B4527; pale porcelain slab #F5EFE4 carries the light screens and the infographic cards
style.typography: bold condensed CJK display headline stacked over a hairline Latin kicker, thin dotted rule beneath, all rendered copy kept as placeholder slots only
